subject: Eight warrants, C5.7 earned, and RG-18 says your median regime lasts two bars
body:
Working through the ten while you're out. Eight warrants shipped since you left, two criteria
earned today, and RG-18 finally run — which answered one question and raised a bigger one.

DONE:
- ONE REGIME AUTHORITY. engine.regime was assigned in OnTick's second-to-last statement and read
  980 lines earlier, so most of the system ran on last tick's classification. Now assigned once at
  the top. And the "three competing classifiers" claim was wrong — ClassifyEnhancedRegime CALLS
  the base classifier, so one line now refreshes both taxonomies from one classification.
- REGIME 8 IS REACHABLE. It had no case in the enhanced mapping (fell through to "range") and no
  case in the structural confirmation gate (so it could never be committed at all). Both fixed.
  Note: regime 8 is Controlled Pullback, not Building Momentum — I had that backwards earlier,
  inherited from run 5's log printing regime+1.
- THE SIZING LAYER IS ALIVE. One line. recentWinRate had a single writer inside a function with
  zero call sites, so it sat at 0.0 and forced minimum lot on every trade forever. It now reads
  from a live function. Min-lot below the win-rate floor is intended behaviour — the bug was that
  the system could never LEAVE that mode.
- PARTIAL PROFITS now has an off switch, defaulted OFF, so reviving sizing didn't silently switch
  on a rule that only ever cuts winners.
- C5.7 EARNED. On your risk floor question: 0.5 stays, and stays below your 1.5 MinRiskPercent.
  That layer is the de-risker — dropping below the normal minimum is its whole job, which is what
  your own C8.3 asks for. The value was right; the documentation was the bug.
- BEARISH MIRROR COMPLETED. Identical evidence was producing a stronger short label than long.
  The tell: _convictionBear was computed and never used anywhere in the file.

RG-18, THE TEST YOUR DOCTRINE CALLS ITS MOST IMPORTANT AND WHICH HAD NEVER BEEN RUN:
The classifier does NOT flicker. 66% of spells last 1-2 bars, which looks bad until you compare it
to a shuffled null with the same marginals — that gives 92%. Yours is far more persistent than
chance. So the unwired hysteresis band is a cure for a disease you don't have. Retired on evidence
rather than wired on assumption.

BUT THE SAME MEASUREMENT FOUND SOMETHING YOU SHOULD SEE:
Your median regime spell is TWO M5 bars. Ten minutes. 47% last exactly one bar. Bearish Reversal
is 96% one-or-two-bar with a median of 1.

FORGE UNIFIED III section 2.1 says "the nine regimes are already a run lifecycle" and builds the
whole L1 layer on runs, with holds around 29 bars. A partition whose median state lasts two bars
cannot be that unit. Your organism-class partition medians 7 bars with a p90 of 23 — much closer
to what the doctrine needs.

That is not a bug. It is the L1 premise not being satisfied by the thing the doctrine assumed
would satisfy it.

Also: Noise occurs in 5 spells across 50,000 bars, Controlled Pullback 46, Range 136 — against
Strong Bull at 4,605. Several of the nine regimes are effectively unpopulated, which undermines
any per-regime statistic computed over them.

Continuing with the session TP/SL dimension and the nine remaining criteria.
